connectorsConsole.title: Connectors
connectorsConsole.subtitle: One console for built-in tool approval tiers and external service connections
connectorsConsole.directTrackNote: Connects directly to the official MCP endpoint (the OAuth page is the vendor's own) — no third-party relay, no API key required.
connectorsConsole.managedLocalTrackNote: Installs and runs locally on this machine via stdio — no Composio cloud relay, zero credentials stored off-device.
connectorsConsole.supersededByDirect: This connection runs through Composio, but the service now ships as a direct connection to the official endpoint (no third-party approval needed). Use “Switch track” to disconnect and clear its config, then reconnect directly from the catalog.

updates.foundToast: Found updates or tool changes for {count} connector(s)
updates.upToDateToast: All connectors are up to date
updates.driftBannerTitle: Remote MCP tool schema changes detected
updates.desktopUpstreamNote: Upstream GitHub released {upstream}; this client pins hash-verified {pinned}.

builtinGroupDesc.email_write: High-frequency reversible email actions: flag / archive / pin / resync to Notion.
builtinGroupDesc.draft: Create and edit local drafts; sending has its own confirmation card.
builtinGroupDesc.web: Web search and page fetching (URLs and query strings leave the machine).
builtinGroupDesc.calendar: Reschedule / RSVP / delete calendar events (delete is destructive).
builtinGroupDesc.capability: Skill toggles and identity-document changes (all with history and rollback).
builtinGroupDesc.supply: Skill install, uninstall, and draft create / write-file / read / validate (supply chain; install always double-confirms).
builtinGroupDesc.agents: Create / update / delete / run-now for Custom Agents, plus calling an Agent from chat.
builtinGroupDesc.exec: Local file read-write and command execution (command bypass rides the policy whitelist).
builtinGroupDesc.outbound: Sending email and outbound-call tools (irreversible or data-egress; always confirm by default).

builtinReadOnlyTools.supply: This group also includes read-only tools with no approval profile: skill_draft_read and skill_draft_validate.
builtinReadOnlyTools.agents: This group also includes read-only tools with no approval profile: custom_agent_list and custom_agent_get.

config.contextDocsHint: Checked docs are injected into the report-generation prompt
config.contextDocsNote: Checked identity docs are injected into the report-generation system prompt (default: SOUL + USER; none checked = no injection).
config.dayOfMonthHint: Limited to days 1–28 so it fires every month (avoids months without a 29th–31st).
config.windowHint: How far back to pull emails when generating
config.kosHint: Attach Gbrain knowledge-base profile snippets for key projects / senders

config.timezoneFromSchedule: Natural-day bounds use the schedule timezone above ({tz}).
config.bodyPrioritiesHint: Checked priorities get full body; others summary-only (no attachments)
config.aggWeekly: Weekly auto-aggregates the past 7 days' daily reports; missing days are noted.
config.aggMonthly: Monthly auto-aggregates the prior natural month's daily reports; missing days are noted.

chats.selectHint: Select a conversation on the left
chats.emptyTranscript: No messages in this conversation yet

search.promptHint: Built-in default search prompt below — edit to override; placeholders auto-filled at runtime
search.toolsHint: Tools this search agent can call (MVP: full-text search only)
search.errConflict: That id already exists — pick another name.

preprocess.markReadAfterProcessingHint: When off, AI still classifies, flags, and updates processing status without changing the message's current read state. Effective on save.
preprocess.contextDocsHint: Checked docs are injected into the classification prompt
preprocess.contextDocsNote: Checked identity docs are injected into the AI email-classification system prompt (default: SOUL + USER).
preprocess.contextDocsInactiveNote: Reference context source is set to "Notion context page"; identity docs are not injected into the classification prompt (selection has no effect here).
preprocess.contextSourceHint: Pick one reference background for the email-classification system prompt (saved instantly, no restart): identity docs or a Notion context page — mutually exclusive, never both.
preprocess.contextPageIdHint: This Notion page's body is injected as reference context into the classification prompt (empty = not injected). env LLM_CONTEXT_PAGE_ID, restart required.
preprocess.webReadOnly: Remote web is read-only: enable state, reference context source and context page ID can't be changed (desktop only); model, fallback and doc selection remain editable.
preprocess.promptViewHint: The mailbox prompt files actually used for classification — one for inbox, one for sent; edit directly, changes take effect on save (no restart needed); identity/preferences come from the docs checked above
preprocess.promptEmpty: File missing or empty — leave blank to classify with only the built-in hard constraints; saved content creates the file automatically
preprocess.promptLoadError: Failed to load classification prompt (serve-api not ready?)
preprocess.promptSaved: Classification prompt saved — effective immediately (no restart needed)

contactGovernance.scheduleHint: One governance scan per day at a fixed hour, alongside the incremental mail sync
contactGovernance.useKosHint: Look up this person's KOS wiki before proposing identity changes; no effect when KOS is not configured.
contactGovernance.promptHint: The default prompt is read-only; your addendum is appended after it
contactGovernance.promptAppendPlaceholder: e.g. company background, department structure, recurring external partners — long-lived context belongs here.
contactGovernance.promptAppendNote: The default prompt already pins the rules that every suggestion cites mail evidence and that identity fields may only be proposed, never written directly; an addendum cannot override that. Empty = default only.
contactGovernance.orgFrameHint: Company and department hierarchy; separate levels with ` / `, put anything outside the frame after a pipe
contactGovernance.orgFramePlaceholder:
# Companies
TP-Link System | tp-link.com.hk | HQ
TP-Link | tp-link.com, omadanetworks.com

# Department frame
EBG / ENBU / Product
Commercial R&D / Systems
contactGovernance.orgFrameNote: Empty = no constraint: the governance agent still proposes, it just stops judging what is off-frame. Once set, suggestions landing outside it carry an “Off-frame” mark so you can extend the frame before adopting.
contactGovernance.queueNote: Suggestions from this agent queue up under Contacts → the “Agent” pill in the list header, and its run history lives there too.
contactGovernance.errFireHour: The daily run hour must be a whole number between 0 and 23

contactProfile.scheduleHint: One pass per day at a fixed hour, capped at this many people
contactProfile.useKosHint: Look up this person's KOS wiki as background before writing the profile; no effect when KOS is not configured.
contactProfile.promptAppendHint: Appended after the built-in profile prompt; empty = built-in only
contactProfile.promptAppendPlaceholder: e.g. Watch for shifts in how they word contract terms.
contactProfile.promptAppendNote: The built-in prompt already pins the rule of citing only the supplied evidence and declining when it is thin; an addendum cannot override that.
contactProfile.errFireHour: The daily run hour must be a whole number between 0 and 23
contactProfile.errDailyLimit: The per-pass cap must be a whole number above 0

projectProgress.subtitle: Matched report emails auto-parse xlsx → sync into the Notion progress database
projectProgress.masterOnNote: Master switch is on (env PROJECT_PROGRESS_SYNC_ENABLED). The enable toggle and trigger rules below take effect on save.
projectProgress.masterOffNote: Master switch is off: the sync will not run. Turn on the master switch below (requires a service restart after saving); the enable toggle and trigger rules are still saved as usual.
projectProgress.masterHint: Env PROJECT_PROGRESS_SYNC_ENABLED; requires a backend restart to take effect
projectProgress.subjectPatternHint: Regex against the email subject; a match marks it as a project report (required)
projectProgress.senderPatternHint: Case-insensitive substring match on the address; empty = any sender
projectProgress.databaseHint: Env PROJECT_PROGRESS_DATABASE_ID (Notion database UUID); requires a restart to take effect
projectProgress.filterBuHint: Exact match on the xlsx BU column; other BUs are dropped; empty = no filter. Env PROJECT_PROGRESS_FILTER_BU; requires a restart
projectProgress.capabilityChip: Project report sync script · built-in, always on
projectProgress.capabilityNote: Runs as a deterministic Python sync script (xlsx parsing → Notion writes) — it does not go through the AI engine and is not part of the skill system, so other skills can't be mounted; use the enable toggle above to stop the whole agent.
projectProgress.webReadOnly: Remote web is read-only: master switch / database ID / BU filter can't be changed (desktop only); the enable toggle and trigger rules remain editable.
projectProgress.errEmptyTrigger: Subject regex and sender cannot both be empty (use the enable toggle above to disable)

avatar.label: Avatar
avatar.hint: Derived from the agent id until you pick one; your choice is saved as an explicit identity
avatar.uploaded: Uploaded image (switch to the Bot tab and pick a shape or color to go back to generated)
avatar.uploadHint: Uploading replaces the generated avatar (≤10MB, auto-cropped and compressed)

uploadErr.not_image: Pick an image file (PNG / JPG / WebP…).
uploadErr.source_too_large: The original is over 10MB — compress it or pick another.
uploadErr.decode_failed: That image could not be read — try another one.
uploadErr.too_large: Still over 150KB at the lowest quality — try a simpler image.

mainAgent.identityHint: Leave empty to keep the default name; the official look is used when no avatar is set

custom.enableHint: When enabled, runs automatically on the trigger below (won't run when trigger is None).
custom.descriptionHint: Shown in the Agent Catalog so the main agent can choose the right specialist.
custom.descriptionPlaceholder: Briefly describe when this agent should be used
custom.promptHint: Instructions injected on each trigger (what the agent should do)
custom.promptPlaceholder: Describe the task the agent should complete on each trigger
custom.errCron5: Cron must be a standard 5-field expression (min hour dom mon dow).
custom.errEmailPredicate: Email trigger needs at least one of: sender / subject / folders / thread IDs.
custom.errCalendarLead: Lead time must be between 1 minute and 30 days.
custom.errMaxRunSeconds: Max run seconds must be between 1 and {max}.
custom.errMaxRunsPerDay: Max runs per day cannot be negative.

trigger.label: Trigger
trigger.hint: Decides when the agent runs automatically
trigger.noneHint: No trigger configured: the agent is saved as a draft and won't run automatically (you can still run it once manually below).
trigger.cronHint: Standard 5-field cron (min hour dom mon dow), e.g. 0 9 * * 1-5 = weekdays at 9am.
trigger.legacyCronHint: Legacy cron config — firing behaviour is unchanged. Switching to the builder is one-way (the builder can't express every cron expression).
trigger.emailHint: Sender / subject are regex; folders and thread IDs are exact allowlists. Fill at least one.
trigger.calendarHint: Business-field changes can trigger runs. Before-start runs fire at event start minus the lead time. Empty calendar names match all calendars.

tools.label: Allowed tools
tools.hint: Tools the agent may call at runtime (intersected within the matrix floor)
tools.unavailable: Tool list unavailable (service not ready or feature off); saving won't change the existing tool config.

capabilities.label: Extra capabilities
capabilities.hint: Capability grants beyond the tool whitelist (web access / command execution)
capabilities.webDisabled: Web access is not enabled (controlled by the MAILAGENT_OPENNESS_WEB_TOOLS environment variable); this grant will have no effect until it is turned on.
capabilities.execDisabled: Command execution is not enabled (controlled by the MAILAGENT_OPENNESS_EXEC_TOOLS environment variable); this grant will have no effect until it is turned on.

capabilityCards.label: Capabilities & permissions
capabilityCards.hint: Choose the work scope first; expand Advanced only for precise tool control
capabilityCards.writeRuleHint: Writes require approval by default. After saving, you can add card-free rules for this agent below.

email.title: Email
email.description: Read mail, organize the inbox, or create and update drafts.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Read events, or propose rescheduling, RSVP, and deletion.
calendar.hitl: Calendar writes always require human approval and cannot use card-free rules.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: Access profile docs, Skills, and KOS knowledge. Off by default.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: The chat-history tools are always available; this sets how far they read: only this agent's own history, or every agent's.
sessions.allHint: All agents = can read the transcripts of other agents and the main agent (including any email content quoted in them).

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Read existing reports or save this run's output as a structured report.
reports.produceHint: Produce writes a local report artifact; it does not send data externally.

web.title: Web
web.description: Search and fetch public pages; web content always remains untrusted data.

files.title: Commands & local files
files.description: Read/write files and run authorized local commands or Skill entrypoints.
files.ruleHint: The grant only admits exec tools; card-free execution still needs a whitelist rule and first-run confirmation.

connectors.title: External services
connectors.description: Grant per-service access to connected external services (MCP); fetched content always remains untrusted data.
connectors.disabledHint: Connector support is off (controlled by MAILAGENT_MCP_CONNECTORS); grants saved here will not take effect yet.
connectors.warn: Writable grants the "read + create + update" ceiling: this agent's background runs may create and modify data in the service (delete is never available).
connectors.empty: No external service is connected yet. Connect one in Settings → AI first, then grant it to this agent here.
connectors.allToolsActive: No per-tool restriction: all tools allowed by the tier remain active
connectors.toolsEmpty: No synced tools yet — sync the connector first in External Connections.

library.title: Library
library.description: Read, search, and write files in the library.
library.writeHint: Writes to Agent docs and “writable” mounted folders — not My docs.
library.readScope: Can read every root, including the mail-attachment projection.
library.headlessNote: Unattended runs skip approval only for Agent docs; mounted folders are always read-only, and move/delete always require approval.

capabilityCards.subsetHint: The enabled tools are a subset of the “{tier}” tier. A tier states the upper bound of granted power, not that every tool in it is on. Expand “Advanced” for the exact list.

computerUse.title: Computer Use automation
computerUse.desc: Allow background runs to automate specific browser domains or desktop apps (requires browser_use / desktop_use).
computerUse.allowSubmitWarn: High risk: allows unattended background runs to execute final submit, approve, or join actions inside the listed scope.

budget.label: Run budget
budget.hint: Caps run frequency and wall-clock duration

runs.pausedPendingHint: Run paused, waiting for approval. Open the execution record to approve, or approve it in the Dynamic Island; it will expire if left unhandled.
runs.pausedExpiredHint: Approval expired; this run was not executed.
runs.skippedHint: The daily run limit was reached, so this trigger was not executed.
runs.specInvalidHint: The agent's configuration could not start this run: it may have been disabled or deleted, or its trigger configuration is invalid. Fix the configuration and try again.
runs.recordBanner: This is an agent execution record — only approvals are interactive (you cannot continue the chat).
runs.approvalBody: {agent} wants to run {tool} — your approval is required.
runs.rememberDomain: Always allow this agent to reach this domain (no approval)
runs.rememberDomainHint: Creates a domain whitelist entry for this agent's unattended runs, so future access to this domain skips approval. Tick only for sources you trust.
runs.editParamsHint: Only the fields below can be changed; the rest are pinned server-side. Approve to run the edited version.
runs.rememberTool: Remember: stop asking about this kind of action
runs.rememberToolHint: Sets {tool} to run automatically in chat from now on. Unattended agent runs are unaffected. Reversible in Settings → AI → tool approval tiers.
runs.approvalExpired: Approval expired (timeout or app restart); this run was not executed.

policy.hint: Approval-free whitelist for this agent's unattended runs. With no rules, every write pauses for your approval (Dynamic Island); actions matching a rule execute without a card. To loosen a rule, delete it and create a new one.
policy.empty: No rules yet. Every write by this agent requires your per-action approval.
policy.dormant: Dormant: the trigger type changed, so this rule no longer matches any run.
policy.modeDerived: Applies to: {mode} (derived from the trigger type, not selectable)

mode.none: no trigger configured (rule will be dormant)

policy.toolNone: This agent's tool whitelist has no write tools (check write tools under "Allowed tools" above and save first).
policy.skillNone: No installed skills (install one under Settings → Custom AI first).
policy.argsHint: Every position must be pin / enum / pattern / path prefix — no raw wildcard.

argPlaceholder.enum: Comma-separated allowed values, e.g. approve, reject

policy.cwdPin: Pin the working directory to this skill's folder
policy.errToolRequired: Pick the write tool to allow.
policy.errEntryRequired: Pick a skill and its entry script.
policy.errInterpreterAbs: The interpreter must be an absolute path (starting with /).
policy.errOriginRequired: Enter the domain or full URL to allow.
policy.originPlaceholder: Domain or full URL, e.g. api.vendor.com or https://api.vendor.com
policy.originHint: An approval-free web domain (the gated-tier whitelist). On submit the server normalizes it to scheme://host:port and echoes it back; different case / port / subdomain count as different origins, and subdomains do not inherit.
policy.warnBody: Once created, "{agent}" will execute {action} without asking you. The rule only applies to {mode}; delete it to restore per-action approval.

grant.label: Allow running local skill scripts (grant_exec)
grant.hint: Opens the exec surface for this agent's unattended runs. Execution still requires a whitelist rule match plus a first-run approval on the Dynamic Island; without a match it pauses per action. Takes effect after saving.
grant.warn: High risk: once enabled, unattended runs of "{agent}" may request executing local skill scripts. Enable?

web.label: Web access (grant_web)
web.hint: Whether this agent's unattended runs may reach the web, and the approval-free scope. Takes effect after saving.
web.searchWarn: Both gated and open allow web_search without approval: the search query goes straight to DuckDuckGo, no per-call prompt.
web.openWarn: Fully open: this agent may fetch any URL without approval — smuggled data can be encoded into the URL and exfiltrated, with only SSRF protection as a backstop.
web.untrustedOpenWarn: Email trigger × fully-open web is the largest exposure combination: a poisoned email can steer content into outbound requests. Enable only for agents you trust.
web.gatedHint: Gated tier: web_fetch is approval-free only when the URL matches a domain in the whitelist below; other domains pause per call (with an "always allow this domain" affordance on the card).

mounts.label: Mounted skills
mounts.hint: The skills visible to this agent's unattended runs (a narrowing surface). Tools of unmounted skills are unavailable to this agent; mounting cannot revive a globally disabled skill.
mounts.empty: Explicit zero mount: this agent has no skill tools.

custom.errComputerUseScope: Computer Use requires at least one concrete domain or app name (wildcards like * or all are not allowed).

agentSettings.builtinToolsNote: Its tools are hard-wired — nothing can be removed or added.
agentSettings.notFound: No configuration found for this member.

model.note: The fallback model is only tried when the primary call fails (timeout, rate limit, or error).

when.manual: On demand · runs when you ask
when.dailyHourOnly: This member runs one batch per day and only supports whole-hour times.

regex.jsNote: Validated with browser regex syntax; a few Python-only constructs (e.g. named groups) may be flagged incorrectly.
regex.tryLabel: Try it on the last 5 subjects
regex.loadFailed: Failed to fetch subjects, try again later

notionDb.invalid: Doesn't look like a Notion database ID: expected 32 hex characters (dashes allowed), or paste the database link

docs.sameSource: The same documents as Settings → AI → Identity documents — editing either place edits the same data.

create.hint: Write its identity and instructions first, then save; scheduling can come later. Chat becomes available after saving.

main.role: Main agent · the global conversation itself

noChat.matterFollowup: Follow-up always belongs to one matter: you chat with it inside that matter, and its run history lives on that matter's page (one timeline per matter). Listed here are the existing matter chats.
noChat.preprocess: It is a pipeline stage that runs automatically on incoming mail, classifying each message — it does not chat. To ask why a message was judged that way, ask the main assistant on that email. Below are the recently classified messages.
noChat.projectProgress: Deterministic flow, no AI involved — there is no reasoning surface to chat with; records only come from its trigger.
noChat.search: Its calling surface is the ⌘K command palette; it keeps no run history and does not chat here.

matterFollowup.title: Matter follow-up
matterFollowup.settingsIntro: These follow-up defaults are shared by every matter: save the task contract with Save; model and web settings apply as soon as you change them. A single matter's own follow-up rule is edited on that matter's page.
matterFollowup.perMatterNote: How often it follows up and what it looks at is decided by each matter's own follow-up rule — edit it in that matter's follow-up settings on the matters page.

record.emptyRuns: No runs yet — it only runs when its trigger fires; manual test runs land here too.
record.emptyReports: No reports yet — scheduled or manual generations will show up here.
record.emptyProgress: No sync records yet — it runs when a weekly-report email matching the trigger words arrives.
record.emptyPreprocess: No recently classified mail — with AI preprocessing enabled, new mail shows up here message by message.
record.emptyMatterSessions: No matter chats yet — once you talk to the AI inside a matter, those conversations show up here.

schedule.report: It runs on its own schedule ({cadence} report); anything you say here is a direct instruction to it.
schedule.daily: It runs automatically once a day; anything you say here is a direct instruction to it.
schedule.timed: It runs on its own schedule ({sentence}); anything you say here is a direct instruction to it.
schedule.timedPlain: It runs on its own schedule; anything you say here is a direct instruction to it.
schedule.event: It runs automatically when mail or calendar events match its trigger; anything you say here is a direct instruction to it.
schedule.manual: It has no schedule — it only acts when you come to it. Anything you say here is a direct instruction to it.

detail.noTranscript: This kind of run creates no session and keeps no transcript — only the result summary.

report.openFromRun: Open the report this run produced

progress.failNote: Nothing was written this time. A deterministic flow never guesses fields — fix the source sheet and resend the email to rerun (a rerun of the same email overwrites this record).

preprocess.failed: This one did not go through
preprocess.failNote: No labels were written for this email. Preprocessing retries with backoff; once the retries run out it stops here — the email itself is intact, it just has no AI labels.

runErrors.E_RUN_TIMEOUT: Timed out before the AI finished
runErrors.E_GATEWAY_DOWN: AI service is not running or unreachable
runErrors.E_GATEWAY_BAD_RESPONSE: AI service returned an unreadable result
runErrors.E_RUN_ACTIVE: Another run is already active in this session

browserPane.modeUnsupportedHint: Switch Browser Use to the built-in managed browser mode to view and interact inline.
